ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 45% high-intensity white/off-white pixels centrally and 55% low-intensity black pixels along the periphery.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central white polygonal region with irregular borders. A distinct, high-contrast white circular feature is isolated within the black distal region near the upper right boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression visible on the left-most boundary of the visible lobe, estimated at approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the upper horizontal boundary with pixel amplitudes ranging from 4 to 10 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve visible along the lower leading edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Tan and brown textured pixel clusters located on the far left leading edge margin, exhibiting a rough, non-uniform spatial distribution.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent vertical dark linear disruption (rake-like) extending from the upper black margin into the central white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A highly distinct, circular white feature or perforation located in the black pigmentation near the distal tip of the lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The geometric precision of the circular white ROI in the distal black region is the primary unique identifier.
